description: Optimisation code, processed data, parameter tables, solver outputs and figures for a multi-stage, multi-objective capacity planning model of domestic critical mineral supply chains under six disruption scenarios. The Zenodo record says it supports the manuscript "Computational Framework for Resilient Domestic Critical Mineral Supply Chains", and that some cost and capacity parameters are scenario proxies because public data are incomplete, which is documented in the package. Keywords are critical minerals, supply chain resilience, capacity planning, optimisation, disruption and import dependence. It was published on 26 August 2026 by Bright Osagie Eze as a single downloadable ZIP of about 0.6 MB under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a domestic supply chain; the country and minerals are not stated on the record read. Caveats: proxy parameters, an unpublished manuscript, and the solver and language are not named on the record read. For simulation it shows how to size processing capacity and stockpiles against import disruptions, a pattern for resilience planning of materials used in energy and transport infrastructure. A related catalogue record is the USGS critical mineral deposits of the United States.
